headline: Senior Data Engineer
summary: Data engineering specialist with over 8 years of experience in architecting scalable data pipelines, optimizing warehouse performance, and implementing robust ETL processes. Proven track record of managing large-scale data infrastructures for financial and technology sectors in Nepal.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate core banking system data for advanced predictive analytics.

experiences.title: Data Engineer
